player_prompt.intro:
Uyimhlali {player_id} kwi-{num_rounds}-round of IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Kuloround, thatha inani phakathi kw-{min_guess} na {max_guess}.
Emva kweguesses zombini, isithetho siyisi (2/3)x(isixhumanisi segezesha zombini),
na umhlali oguess yakhe ilapha kwingakhe kuthetha le round.
Yiphendule ngoguess yakho ngendlela '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ifomathi ayisebenzi; nceda uthumele uqikelelo lwakho njengo [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Uqikelelo kufuneka lube phakathi {min_guess} kunye no-{max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Umhlali 0 wathatha {guess0}; Umhlali 1 wathatha {guess1}. Kwingakhe, Isithetho siyisi: {target}.
